content: The runner repository is the image producer; the web repository is the CI consumer. Publish runner images by immutable digest, and pin the consumer workflow to that digest rather than a mutable tag. Validate the handoff against a clean web checkout before changing ownership or tags.

title: Expose runner digest as consumer handoff
rationale: The producer workflow now exports the verified registry digest as a job output and a retained artifact, while the web consumer remains a separate blocked seed. Local Act defaults to the published senshac-runner image rather than the old mismatched name.

content: The published Flox CI runner must include gnutar so actions/setup-node can extract Node distributions; publish and CI smoke tests assert tar is on PATH.

title: Link tar into the final runner image
rationale: Flox manifest packages gnutar in the build environment, but flox containerize did not expose it in the final runtime PATH. The image construction now links the build-time tar executable to /usr/bin/tar and the publish smoke test verifies that exact final shell resolves and executes /usr/bin/tar.

title: Build the published CI runner directly with Flox
rationale: The runner build now publishes Flox's containerize output unchanged, preserving its activation entrypoint; the publication smoke test invokes the default entrypoint and checks the activated tar, git, gh, sd, ml, tr, and tl tools.

title: Retag Flox output for registry targets
rationale: flox containerize rejects fully qualified GHCR references in this workflow; build with a simple local tag first, preserving Flox's generated entrypoint, then apply the requested target with the selected container runtime.

description: Flox containerize rejects the image-reference-style tag used by the publication helper; use bare --tag ci-runner, then verify senshac-runner:ci-runner exists and retag it with the selected runtime.
resolution: Updated scripts/build-ci-runner to use Flox's bare tag, check the generated source image, and retag it to the requested target.

title: Make runner publication phases observable
rationale: The publication script now emits timestamped GitHub log groups for Flox containerization and runtime retagging, runs flox -vv with line-buffered output, and the workflow groups the immutable-image smoke-test handoff. This preserves the bare Flox source tag and runtime retagging boundary while making CI failures diagnosable.

title: Expose GNU tar through Flox activation
rationale: Install the gnutar package under the tar install ID and group in both manifest and lock metadata. Flox containerize then carries the activated profile bin/tar onto PATH without a post-build symlink, while heredoc smoke tests execute valid Node and Bun network source.

description: PR28's manifest install-ID alias did not make tar resolvable in the activated flox containerize image; the final image needs to inspect actual /nix/store tar/gtar outputs and expose one explicitly.
resolution: Keep gnutar under its real package name, log PATH and package candidates, link the discovered executable into /usr/bin/tar in a derived image, and run smoke verification from a separate script rather than nested docker heredocs.

title: Provide a no-push local runner verification path
rationale: Use scripts/verify-ci-runner-local to build the Flox image with rootless Podman, smoke-test the activated final image, and optionally prepare the Podman socket for Act without registry credentials or changing publish workflow behavior.

title: Copy tar binary across container runtimes
rationale: Flox source images can expose tar differently when exported through Docker versus rootless Podman. The runner builder now follows the discovered tar/gtar path and copies the executable into /usr/bin/tar, then verifies that exact path with the selected runtime before retagging. This avoids relying on a Nix-store symlink surviving runtime export.

description: Committed lock declared gnutar in manifest metadata but omitted its resolved package. Local Flox regenerated it, invalidating earlier Docker-versus-Podman conclusions. Stdin smoke commands also returned success without executing checks; mounted smoke exposed missing gzip.
resolution: Commit Flox-generated resolutions for gnutar and gzip; validate manifest equality and package/system outputs before building; preserve lock digest; mount smoke script through the image entrypoint, assert deliberate exit42 and success marker, test compressed extraction. PR Docker validation precedes main-only publication.

title: Add additive modular Nix OCI surface
rationale: Keep Flox as the current runner producer while flake.nix exposes only the CI-required tool closure and a dockerTools image; developer tools remain Flox until compatibility is proven.

description: OCI flake validation failed in CI because Nix's nix-command experimental feature was disabled.
resolution: Invoke every Nix command in scripts/check-oci-flake with --extra-experimental-features nix-command and document the same portable form for local checks; cover the command prefix with a contract test.

description: OCI flake validation still failed after enabling nix-command because flakes remained disabled in the verify-image path.
resolution: Pass both nix-command and flakes in --extra-experimental-features for every flake, eval, and build invocation, and assert the combined flag in the regression test.

title: Keep OCI flake validation lockfile-clean
rationale: Every flake check, eval, and build invocation in scripts/check-oci-flake now passes --no-write-lock-file, with contract coverage and matching documentation, preventing verify-image from dirtying the Git tree.

description: OCI verify-image built the metadata derivation but its exact-line grep assertions failed after PR #45; heredoc formatting made the metadata writer sensitive to Nix shell-string indentation.
resolution: Write the contract with printf line arguments instead of a heredoc, and cover every exact metadata line plus the absence of the heredoc in the flake contract tests.

title: Validate OCI archive through build and metadata parsing
rationale: The OCI check now evaluates stable public names, builds ciTools and ociImage, and parses metadata with shell key/value assertions instead of grep or heredoc contracts. Size metrics remain documented as a TODO because CI does not yet provide reliable measurements for both Nix and Flox outputs.

title: Match dockerTools archive derivation name in OCI validation
rationale: dockerTools.buildLayeredImage evaluates the public ociImage attribute to senshac-runner-oci.tar.gz; keep the exact eval assertion aligned with that Docker-compatible archive while preserving the ociImage attribute.

title: Report CI image sizes without ratio assumptions
rationale: The verify workflow measures Flox compressed and inspect sizes plus Nix archive size from the same run, with optional loaded Nix inspect size; measurement gaps remain unavailable rather than masking build or smoke failures.

title: Canary Nix OCI image through existing smoke contract
rationale: Keep Flox build and smoke verification unchanged while verify-ci-runner loads ociImage as senshac-runner-oci:modular and runs the same smoke script; use an argument-forwarding shell entrypoint so command execution and failure propagation match the harness.

description: The runner smoke contract validates required executables with a shell loop (), so tests must assert the loop's tool list and variable lookup rather than a literal /usr/bin/tar line.
resolution: Keep the Nix image minimal and make tests parse the loop and compare its exact required tool list.

title: Use runtime-mounted Flox overlay for Nix base
rationale: The Nix OCI image now keeps only CI essentials plus profile/bootstrap scripts; minimal mode is hermetic and Flox activation validates the repository lock at runtime, avoiding legacy environment duplication and per-repository image rebuilds.

title: Report OCI variants with explicit unavailable states
rationale: Keep archive and loaded-runtime measurements separate, compare each to the Nix base, and mark the absent minimal Flox manifest and runtime-mounted overlay footprint unavailable instead of counting the base twice.

title: Keep minimal Flox comparison manifest separate
rationale: The full .flox/env developer contract stays unchanged; .flox/ci carries a separately locked shared CI tool closure, and the verification workflow builds it beside Nix and full Flox measurements.

description: PR #55 left the dedicated minimal .flox/ci lock manifest with a stale gzip pkg-group entry, so verify-image failed before image smoke.
resolution: Regenerated the minimal lock manifest to match manifest.toml by removing the stale gzip pkg-group entry; keep .flox/ci separate from the full .flox/env contract.

description: The configured Warren quality gate is scripts/act-ci, but this runner checkout has no SENSHAC_WEB_REPO clean web checkout; the gate exits with usage status 2. Host verification also lacks the pinned Flox and container runtime binaries.
resolution: Run the committed lock fix in the Warren host with a clean web checkout and pinned Flox 1.16.0; leave the follow-up seed in progress until verify-image and act-ci pass.

title: Verify workflow consumes one producer archive set
rationale: The PR verification workflow now builds full Flox, minimal Flox, and Nix OCI images once, uploads immutable archives, and makes a dependent job download/load those exact bytes for smoke tests and measurements. Cross-workflow reuse remains digest-pinned through GHCR.

description: The configured full quality gate is scripts/act-ci, but this runner workspace has no SENSHAC_WEB_REPO clean web checkout; the gate exits 2 with its usage message.
resolution: Keep the image artifact refactor committed and rerun scripts/act-ci from Warren with a clean web checkout before closing the seed.

title: Reuse validated OCI output and archive provenance
rationale: The PR verification workflow now validates each full/minimal lock once, builds each image once, passes the OCI archive link through check-oci-flake, and verifies archive checksums plus image IDs after artifact download. Publish retains an immutable archive and metadata alongside the registry digest.

description: Combined producer verification hid which exported image failed because minimal Flox and Nix checks ran in one shell block with silent assertions.
resolution: Keep each producer verification in its own workflow step and make every retained assertion emit a diagnostic before failing.

title: Separate PR validation from post-merge publication
rationale: CI now validates runner changes once on pull_request, image verification builds immutable producer archives only for relevant PR paths, and main publication alone builds and publishes after merge with canceling concurrency and digest handoff. Documented the event matrix to preserve required checks and provenance.

description: The configured full quality gate ./scripts/act-ci cannot start in the runner-only checkout because SENSHAC_WEB_REPO is unset and the live web repository is not mounted.
resolution: Run ./scripts/act-ci with SENSHAC_WEB_REPO pointing to a clean senshac-web checkout in Warren host validation; retain focused bash syntax and diff checks locally.

title: Package Chromium through Flox for runner smoke contract
rationale: The published Flox image now declares Chromium in the committed environment manifest and verifies activated Bun plus a headless Chromium launch, keeping browser runtime libraries in the Nix package closure without apt or runtime installs.

title: Publish CI runner from Nix dockerTools
rationale: The published producer now validates the committed Flox manifest/lock, builds the minimal flake OCI archive with pkgs.dockerTools, and packages Chromium plus its runtime closure; publication keeps immutable sha tags and digest verification while Flox activation remains optional.

title: Use one Nix dockerTools producer
rationale: Removed the separate .flox/ci comparison image and Flox containerize helpers. Pull-request verification now builds and uploads only the flake ociImage, while the committed .flox/env manifest and lock remain the source contract validated before dockerTools assembly.

title: Use Flox activation as the runner tool source
rationale: The Nix dockerTools image now contains only base shell/runtime, Flox CLI, certificates, and an activation wrapper; mounted projects provide Bun, Chromium, and all other tools through their committed manifest.lock.

title: Pin Flox CLI from upstream flake
rationale: nixpkgs does not provide the Flox CLI as a package attribute; the dockerTools base now consumes the pinned upstream Flox flake package while mounted manifests continue to supply non-base tools.
